description: This is the first of a two-part course sequence on artificial intelligence and machine learning. This course introduces the foundational concepts and techniques in machine learning and artificial intelligence. Students will explore supervised and unsupervised learning, focusing on algorithms like linear regression, decision trees, and k-nearest neighbors. Emphasis will be placed on understanding practical knowledge such as model evaluation, feature engineering, and overfitting. Through hands-on assignments, students will gain practical experience applying these methods to real-world datasets. Students will also be exposed to various business applications of machine learning.
